registration_scope: Retrospective reproducibility record of the fixed executed comparison. Not a formal preregistration.
target: Same second conditional Taylor residual R2 under each of 36 frozen synthetic GBM/payoff cases. This compares transport orders, not R1 versus R2 pricing corrections.

common_inputs.nodes: Actual original dyadic rounded nodes, certified inside retained equal-CDF cells. Same raw Gaussian retained mass.
common_inputs.norms_and_geometry: Same global payoff boundary norms, E1/E2 residual geometry, dispersion moment information and full Gaussian tail for both orders.

competitors.FTC: Positive absolute weighted fundamental-theorem-of-calculus measure rho0, residual derivative E1, exact Gaussian transforms and shared finite hybrid moment closure. Transparent actual-grid adaptation; not verbatim implementation of Herman et al. (2026) uniform physical-coordinate left-endpoint theorem.
competitors.second_order: Published centred Peano cell identity specialised from Cerone (2002), rho1 plus rho2, residual E1/E2 and same finite hybrid moment closure.
competitors.partition_scope: Nested contiguous blocks in the transported coordinate only. B1 aggregate; B1024 transported-coordinate cellwise with all other coordinates independently factorised. No Cartesian price enumeration or unknown-price input.
competitors.finite_arithmetic: Hierarchy uses valid minimum of parent and summed-child upper bounds; raw outward upper increases retained in audit (zero here).

timing.per_level_scope: Geometry record, grouped polynomial moments and both FTC/Peano allowances for twelve payoffs (three common scales times four payoffs) in that asset family.
timing.cache_scope: B1 forms fresh GroupedGeometry coefficients; later levels reuse them and existing caches.
timing.excluded: Common BlockTransport prefix setup is separate. Per-level timings exclude serialisation, full audit, archive compaction/reconstruction and earlier quantum precision search.
timing.unsupported_inference: Joint timings are not order-specific construction times, cold-run speed ratios, single-price execution times or quantum-device runtimes.

outcomes.failure_interpretation: Earlier sharper local two-asset certificates remain available. No original complete pricing case becomes unsupported.

claim_boundary: Second-order allowances are smaller in this cohort. No general uniform ordering, refinement-theory priority, complete-price/confidence guarantee from this allocation alone, newly reduced quantum cap, empirical validation or practical quantum advantage is established.
